column1: # The Wiener convolve gets its FIRST vector arm, and the port gets its FIRST AVX-512 tier.
# base = origin/main 84621b20 (the cdef find_dir commit). cand = this commit.
# host = r7900x (AMD Ryzen 9 7900X, **ZEN 4**, 24 threads, Linux 7.0.0-30), qp 40.
#        Zen 4 double-pumps AVX-512 over 256-bit units, so a 512-bit arm buys
#        instruction count and front-end width here, NOT execution width — which
#        is what these numbers show (instructions -3.27/-5.65 %, IPC unmoved).
#        ZEN 5 (full-width 512-bit datapath) WAS NOT MEASURED. Do not
#        extrapolate these onto it in either direction.
# ---- 1. WALL CLOCK. tools/perf_ab.sh, 21 interleaved randomised paired rounds,
#         neither side niced, EVERY cell ident=Y. Each candidate A/B is paired
#         with a SAME-BINARY control (base vs a byte copy of base) taken in the
#         SAME session — the control is this harness's floor for that cell.
#         median of 5 per leg, every run `taskset -c 20`. THIS is the only
#         instrument that sees the _v4 arm (see section 3).
# photo_cid p6: instructions -3.27 % against a control that moved +0.004 %;
#               cycles -2.81 % against a control that moved -0.47 %.
#         init+encode). VALGRIND MASKS AVX-512 IN CPUID, so `X64V4Token::summon()`
#         returns None under it and the port runs its **_v3** arm. Every Ir below
#         therefore prices the AVX2 arm, NOT the AVX-512 one. Verified, not
#         assumed: the callgrind output names `wiener_convolve_simd_v3` and never
#         `_v4`. The same masking is why the new tier is callgrind-SAFE — no
#         SIGILL, archmage just degrades one tier.
# Cross-check: the candidate's callgrind .obu is byte-identical to the REAL C
# ---- 4. THE TIER IS REAL, AND IT RUNS. objdump of
# And the tier the dispatch SELECTS, printed by the new unit test:
# ---- 5. MEMORY. tools/mem_gate.sh, `/usr/bin/time -l` peak RSS, median of 3,
#         aarch64 M4 Pro, gradient qp 32 preset 6. No cost either way.
# The 2-frame cell is ident=N (outside the byte-identical frontier), so read its
# two RSS figures as absolutes, not as a ratio between equal work.
#         (a one-off on the vertical centre tap, inside the vector body only):
#         wiener_simd_all_tiers_match_materialised FAILS on the first shape
